business_problem: prioritize cyber risk across many security tools and threat feeds fast enough to give customers clear remediation guidance and scalable automation.
solution_summary: Vulcan Cyber uses Snowflake and its ExposureOS platform to aggregate billions of security signals into a scalable cyber-risk analytics and remediation service. Findings from security scanners, asset inventories, more than 100 threat intelligence feeds, and customer-specific business-context sources are centralized in Snowflake, where they are correlated, deduplicated, and scored to prioritize the vulnerabilities that matter most. ExposureOS serves the resulting risk scores, customizable reports, remediation guidance, and automation workflows to customer teams, while new AI features help users search in natural language and read human-friendly CVE summaries. Because Snowflake provides the throughput to ingest huge datasets and keep analysis close to the data, Vulcan can deliver timely insights, support full automation options, and add new AI models quickly instead of fighting scale limits.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Stores and processes Vulcan Cyber’s unified threat, asset, and business-context datasets at scale.

solution_components.name: ExposureOS
solution_components.role: Delivers prioritized risk views, remediation guidance, reporting, and automation workflows to customers.

data_flow: Security findings, asset inventories, and over 100 threat intelligence feeds are ingested into Snowflake, where they are deduplicated and enriched with customer business context. ExposureOS then presents the prioritized vulnerabilities, AI-generated summaries, and remediation actions to security teams.
integration_points: customer remediation scripts and patch workflows
business_outcome: Vulcan Cyber can now integrate more than 100 threat feeds, deliver complex analysis work in about an hour instead of days, and build new AI summarization capability in a single day.
